content:
Factor \(17017\):
\[
17017 = 7\cdot 11\cdot 13\cdot 17.
\]
So any positive divisor of \(17017^{17}\) has the form
\[
7^a 11^b 13^c 17^d
\]
where \(0\le a,b,c,d\le 17\).

Now reduce modulo \(12\):
\[
13\equiv 1 \pmod{12},
\]
so \(13^c\equiv 1\) for all \(c\). Also,
\[
7^a\equiv 
\begin{cases}
1 & a \text{ even},\\
7 & a \text{ odd},
\end{cases}
\]
\[
11^b\equiv 
\begin{cases}
1 & b \text{ even},\\
11 & b \text{ odd},
\end{cases}
\]
\[
17^d\equiv 5^d\equiv 
\begin{cases}
1 & d \text{ even},\\
5 & d \text{ odd}.
\end{cases}
\]
We need the product to be \(5\pmod{12}\). Checking parity combinations:

- \(a\) even, \(b\) even, \(d\) odd:
  \[
  1\cdot 1\cdot 5=5.
  \]
- \(a\) odd, \(b\) odd, \(d\) even:
  \[
  7\cdot 11\cdot 1=77\equiv 5 \pmod{12}.
  \]

All other parity combinations fail.

In the range \(0\) to \(17\), there are \(9\) even and \(9\) odd choices for each of \(a,b,d\), and \(18\) choices for \(c\). Thus the number of valid divisors is
\[
N=2\cdot 9^3\cdot 18 = 2\cdot 729\cdot 18 = 26244.
\]
Therefore,
\[
N \bmod 1000 = 244.
\]
\[
\boxed{244}
\]
